ai_summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited has announced that BSE and NSE have granted in-principle approval for the listing of 3,34,96,434 equity shares of Tieramet Limited, issued pursuant to a Composite Scheme of Arrangement. This is a material step forward for the corporate restructuring, allowing the new shares to potentially be traded on the exchanges. However, the listing remains highly conditional, dependent on the submission of numerous outstanding documents and fulfillment of regulatory compliances, indicating that final approval and trading are not yet guaranteed.
